name: cemetery illuminator
mana cost: {1}{U}{U}
types: creature spirit
power toughness: 2/3
static: flying
triggered: when CARDNAME enters or attacks, exile a card from a graveyard.
static: you may look at the top card of your library any time.
static: once each turn, you may cast a spell from the top of your library if it shares a card type with a card exiled with CARDNAME.
